newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium halts construction of Kenya bullets plant.
newsitem.headline: Belgium halts construction of Kenya bullets plant.

text.p: Belgian Foreign Trade and Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Thursday the construction of a munitions plant in Kenya with the support of a Belgian arms company would be halted for the time being.

Maystadt told parliament the plant in Eldoret would only be finished once Kenya gave Belgium formal guarantees that it would not supply bullets to countries in the turbulent central African Great Lakes area, made up of Zaire, Rwanda and Burundi.
He said an agreement in principle existed, but this needed to be formalised. "Until then I will not allow any transfers of technology, material or machines."
Maystadt is responsible for export licences for companies in Belgium's french-speaking southern half. Foreign Minister Erik Derycke handles export licences for Flemish companies.
Belgian arms manufacturer Fabrique Nationale Herstal, part of French Giat Group, is helping to build the Eldoret plant by supplying machinery.
Ethnic tension between Hutus and Tutsis remains high in civil-war torn Burundi and Rwanda and the Zairean government is fighting to recapture rebel-held territory in the east of the country.
